What is the plot of "Disclosure Day"?

"Lanterns" will definitely be headed to space in its debut season on HBO and HBO Max. (Image credit: HBO/HBO Max) A sci-fi conspiracy thriller with elements of mystery and action, "Disclosure Day" is essentially "Snowden", only with a UFO angle instead of surveillance.

Cybersecurity specialist Daniel Kellner (Josh O’Connor) decides to turn whistleblower upon discovering that the US government has been suppressing evidence of extra-terrrestrial life, as part of a cover-up that goes back decades.

Beware the power of "Lanterns" when it lands on Aug. 16, 2026 (Image credit: Universal Pictures) Naturally, that make Daniel the No.1 enemy of the state and Noah Scanlon (Colin Firth), the CEO of shady government contractor Wardex, orchestrates a concerted campaign of violence to silence him for good.

Only, Daniel isn't acting alone. In a seemingly random twist, meteorologist Margaret Fairchild (Emily Blunt) has his back, but to piece the puzzle together they must first find each other.

Are there any "Disclosure Day" teasers and trailers?

The initial teaser gave so little away it was more baffling than intriguing, especially as the "Disclosure Day" plot details had been so tightly under wraps at that point, but subsequent drops were far more revealing – perhaps slightly too much so...

The trailers, however, were duly upstaged by Steven Spielberg's seemingly earnest assurance, referring to the plot, that "all of this is true."

Who are the "Disclosure Day"' cast and creators?

(Image credit: Universal Pictures) "Disclosure Day" features an ensemble cast, led by:

- Emily Blunt – Margaret Fairchild

- Josh O'Connor – Dr. Daniel Kellner

- Colin Firth – Noah Scanlon

- Eve Hewson – Jane Blankenship

- Colman Domingo – Hugo Wakefield

- Wyatt Russell – Jackson

- Henry Lloyd-Hughes – Casper Boyd

Produced by Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment, "Disclosure Day" was written by David Koepp and directed by Steven Spielberg, with a score by John Williams. Spielberg and Kristie Macosko Krieger served as executive producers.
